script.code:
SELECT CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       o.event_id,
       o.event_type,
       o.organization_id,
       o.plant_id,
       o.aggregate_id,
       o.aggregate_no,
       o.job_id,
       o.payload_hash,
       o.correlation_id,
       o.payload,
       o.dispatch_status,
       o.attempt_count,
       o.row_version,
       o.is_deleted,
       (o.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND o.lease_expires_at > NOW(3)) AS lease_live,
       (o.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR o.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)) AS due,
       g.gd_status,
       g.is_deleted AS gd_deleted,
       g.organization_id AS gd_org,
       j.job_status,
       j.is_deleted AS job_deleted,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS job_gd_id,
       CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id,
       (c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.consumed_at > NOW(3) - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS claim_live,
       k.consumption_status AS cons_status
  FROM gd_outbox o
  LEFT JOIN goods_delivery g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = CAST(o.aggregate_id AS UNSIGNED)
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = CAST(o.job_id AS UNSIGNED)
  LEFT JOIN gd_event_consumption c
    ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND c.event_id = o.event_id
   AND c.consumer_name = (CONCAT('PICK_CLAIM_', o.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND c.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN gd_event_consumption k
    ON k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND k.event_id = o.event_id
   AND k.consumer_name = 'GD_PICKING_OUTBOX_CONSUMER'
   AND k.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.event_type = 'GD_COMMITTED'
   AND o.is_deleted = 0
   AND (('{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.mode}}' = 'ID' AND o.event_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.eventIdSql}}')
        OR ('{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.mode}}' = 'POLL'
            AND (o.dispatch_status = 'READY' OR (o.dispatch_status = 'CLAIMED' AND (o.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR o.lease_expires_at <= NOW(3))))
            AND (o.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR o.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3))
            AND g.gd_status = 'Created'
            AND g.is_deleted = 0
            AND (j.job_status IN ('GD_COMMITTED', 'CREATING_PICKING', 'PICKING_RETRYING', 'PICKING_READY')
                 OR (j.job_status = 'COMPLETED' AND k.consumption_status = 'DONE')
                 OR (j.job_status = 'REQUIRES_REVIEW' AND k.consumption_status = 'FAILED'))
            AND j.is_deleted = 0
            AND (c.id IS NULL OR c.consumed_at <= NOW(3) - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)))
 ORDER BY o.create_time, o.id
 LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       t.to_id,
       t.to_status,

script.code:
SELECT CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       o.dispatch_status,
       o.row_version,
       c.consumption_status,
       c.target_type,
       c.target_id,
       c.target_no,
       j.job_status,
       CAST(j.picking_id AS CHAR) AS picking_id,
       j.picking_no
  FROM gd_outbox o
  LEFT JOIN gd_event_consumption c
    ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND c.event_id = o.event_id
   AND c.consumer_name = 'GD_PICKING_OUTBOX_CONSUMER'
   AND c.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = CAST(o.job_id AS UNSIGNED)
 WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_3wpgxjXW.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.id = {{node:code_node_3onV21Rv.data.eventRowId}}
